# Philosophy Quotes About Action: Thinkers, Sources & Context

> Philosophy quotes about action: read 30 verified English passages with sources. Action concerns agency: what it is to do something intentionally, and how thought becomes practice.

Theme

## Philosophy quotes about action

Action concerns agency: what it is to do something intentionally, and how thought becomes practice.

30 passages · 8+ thinkers in this selection

### Why this theme matters

Philosophy of action asks how intentions, reasons, habits, and consequences hang together. Ethical traditions often insist that knowing the good is incomplete without doing it.

### In the history of philosophy

Aristotelian praxis, Confucian unity of knowledge and action, Stoic exercises, and modern theories of intentionality all contribute to this theme.

### Thinkers in this collection

[Aristotle](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/aristotle) , [Seneca](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/seneca) , [Voltaire](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/voltaire) , [Hannah Arendt](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/hannah-arendt) , [William James](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/william-james) , [Auguste Comte](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/auguste-comte) , [Xunzi](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/xunzi) , [Laozi](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/laozi)

### Frequently asked questions

#### What is action in philosophy?

An action is typically a deed done for a reason, as opposed to a mere bodily event or accident.

#### Why do philosophers connect action and ethics?

Because moral evaluation usually concerns what agents do, intend, and could have done otherwise.

#### Which traditions emphasize practice over theory?

Stoicism, Confucianism, pragmatism, and many Buddhist schools treat practice as the test of understanding.
